name: Szalkszentmárton (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, white and yellow in the ratio 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szalkszentmárton (a green shield with yellow trefoils and a heart within a yellow frame) above the name SZALKSZENTMÁRTON in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szalkszentmárton arms in a yellow frame
